tbesh_html:
1) to seek out, swell, cause to swell, boil up, enquire
1a) (Qal)
1a1) to seek, enquire
1a2) to cause to boil up
1b) (Niphal)
1b1) to be searched out
1b2) to be swelling, bulging, swelling out

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to gush over, i.e. to swell; (figuratively) to desire earnestly; by implication to ask
strongs_1890.kjv_def: cause, inquire, seek up, swell out.
